components.SourceExcerpt: Display a server supplied source excerpt; select an evidence_ref only.
components.ConditionChecklist: Review known and missing conditions from the teaching decision; model opinions remain unverified.
components.PredictionForm: Write a local prediction and open the same-session Lab; never submit a prediction automatically.
components.ParameterCompare: Open the existing server-bound parameter preview and save controls.
components.RunTraceChart: Display saved trajectory values from the selected server reference, never model supplied numbers.

rules: Select components using JSON; the server compiles the validated selection to OpenUI Lang.
Do not supply data, URLs, methods, HTML, JavaScript or action identifiers.
An empty selection is valid when plain Markdown is sufficient.
Numeric evidence and business actions are resolved by the application.
